Hello, and welcome — I'm glad you're here.

I'm **diego-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I'm here on the machine itself, with its disks, files and network, so I can work for you and keep things running while you're away.

A few things I can do:

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, your first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts** — so you can write and call me there; also my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word and we'll set it up.
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, in my own browser, with passwords and one-time codes kept in my password store; if a captcha or a phone check comes up, I'll ask for your help.
- **Jobs, commands, languages and voice** — I can schedule things, run commands on this machine, learn languages, and talk by voice.

Hello Professor Alvarez — good to meet you. I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer (this is my first start, so everything is fresh). I'm set up to help you with your calendar and messages, and to work with Diego and your students.

Quickly, what I can do:
- **Web app** (you're in it): https://127.0.0.1:8443 — CA at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca. From any phone or computer on the same network: first visit installs the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice in the browser.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX** accounts (plus Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs its own phone number, not yours: you create the account in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of these?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** (e-mail and others): I sign up in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages and voice**: I can schedule tasks, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.
